inputs.name: hand over from Model Performance Monitoring to Alerting System

output.level_0: Alerts fire randomly during the morning window, blocking the order suggestion feed without explanation.
output.level_1: No alerts exist, so silent forecast failures go unnoticed until empty shelves appear on Saturday.
output.level_2: A team member manually checks monitoring dashboards each morning and emails alerts to the channel.
output.level_3: The system automatically pushes alerts to the on call engineer when performance metrics degrade.
output.level_4: Alerts trigger governed workflows, ensuring compliance checks and audit logs accompany every notification.
